name: climateshield-nexus
description: AI-Powered Climate Risk Intelligence Platform for Africa — monorepo root. See README.md and docs/38_Project_Structure.md.
//workspaces: Glob patterns only, so a directory that is still a docs-only scaffold (no package.json yet) is skipped rather than breaking `npm install` for everyone. Add a concrete path here only once that package actually exists.

scripts.//lint: Lint every workspace package. Wired into .github/workflows/lint.yml
scripts.//build: npm does not topologically sort workspaces, so http-errors (which every other shared package imports) must be built explicitly first. Once it has emitted its .d.ts, the rest are independent of each other and the alphabetical --workspaces pass is safe.
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @climateshield/http-errors && npm run build -w @climateshield/response-envelope -w @climateshield/rbac-guard -w @climateshield/event-bus -w @climateshield/storage-client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
